message.content:
The editorial illustration for Tempo magazine, dated June 20-26, 2016, features a white background dominated by orange and black elements. A man wearing glasses and a light-colored, short-sleeved uniform stands center-right. He holds a red-and-white lifebuoy around his waist. He is positioned on a horizontal surface composed of numerous orange hands reaching upward. To his left, a large, wave-like mass is formed by dozens of interconnected orange hands and arms. Some of these hands grasp green banknotes.

The large black text "TEMPO" is at the top. Above it, text reads "TITO KARNAVIAN: SAYA KENAL AGUAN DAN TOMY WINATA." A small portrait of a man’s face is in the top right corner. To the right of the central figure, the text reads "DUIT REKLAMASI UNTUK TEMAN-TEMAN AHOK" in large black letters. Below this, smaller black text states, "KPK menelusuri dugaan aliran dana pengembang reklamasi ke relawan Ahok. Kesaksian pembawa uang." At the bottom left, a barcode, price "RP 39.500," and date "20-26 JUNI 2016" are visible. The magazine logo "TEMPO 45 1971-2016" appears in red and yellow is at the top left.
